name: mem3-extraction-confidence-defaulted-again
find: const { text, sourceEventIds, confidence, sensitivity } = value;
replace:
const { text, sourceEventIds, sensitivity } = value;
  const confidence: unknown = (value as { confidence?: unknown }).confidence ?? 1;
expect: rejects a proposal that omits confidence

name: mem3-extraction-sensitivity-defaulted-again

edits.replace: // mutation: an unknown sensitivity stops being refused here

edits.find:
text: text.trim(),
    sourceEventIds: Object.freeze([...(sourceEventIds as string[])]),
    confidence,
    sensitivity,
    origin: "model",
edits.replace:
text: text.trim(),
    sourceEventIds: Object.freeze([...(sourceEventIds as string[])]),
    confidence,
    sensitivity: (sensitivity === "normal" || sensitivity === "sensitive" ? sensitivity : "normal") as typeof sensitivity,
    origin: "model",

expect: rejects a proposal with an unknown sensitivity

name: mem3-hourly-filing-confidence-defaulted-again
replace:
const filingConfidence = typeof record.filingConfidence === "number"
    && Number.isFinite(record.filingConfidence)
    && record.filingConfidence >= 0 && record.filingConfidence <= 1
    ? record.filingConfidence : 0;
expect: rejects a proposal whose filingConfidence is missing or out of range rather than defaulting it
